phase1_core_families.name: Pendulums & Oscillators
phase1_core_families.verifiable_focus: Single pendulum and damped spring-mass first (double pendulum deferred); phase, rod length, and damping envelope

phase1_core_families.name: Collisions & Elastic Bounce
phase1_core_families.verifiable_focus: Two-body collision & squash-and-stretch recovery; exact impact instant and post-impact trajectory

phase1_core_families.name: Planar Linkages & Gears
phase1_core_families.verifiable_focus: Joint closure, spin direction, and gear ratio (blocks background-only fake motion)

phase1_core_families.name: Optics Rays & Waveforms
phase1_core_families.verifiable_focus: Ray intersections and wave crest phases with explicit coordinate system & units in prompt

phase1_core_families.name: Ripples & Bounded Particles
phase1_core_families.verifiable_focus: Deterministic PRNG seed, exact out-of-order seek reproducibility at same t, explicit trail/clear contract

phase1_core_families.name: Geometric Constructions & Proofs
phase1_core_families.verifiable_focus: Epicycles/circle tracing, similar triangles, auxiliary lines, and verifiable angles

phase1_core_families.name: Algorithms & Data Narratives
phase1_core_families.verifiable_focus: Array/path state synchronized with rendered bars/nodes, dynamic legend, and highlight callouts

phase1_core_families.name: Horology & Rhythmic Symmetry
phase1_core_families.verifiable_focus: Offline beat timing, tick-mark precision, symmetric morphing, and periodic seam position+velocity continuity

phase1_core_families.name: Parallax Atmospheric Scenes
phase1_core_families.verifiable_focus: 3-layer relative scroll rates, subject occlusion order, camera continuity (eligible for style reference-image A/B)

phase1_core_families.name: Vector Growth & Brand Kinetic Typography
phase1_core_families.verifiable_focus: SVG home turf: path stroke-dashoffset length, letter spacing, viewBox non-clipping, one-shot terminal state

phase1_core_families.name: UI State Transitions
phase1_core_families.verifiable_focus: Trigger responsiveness, clean pause freeze, and deterministic recovery after interruption

phase1_core_families.name: Interactive Explainers
phase1_core_families.verifiable_focus: Analytic orbits or single-parameter physical controls tested at fixed parameter-change instants
